posts.cooked: Went almost this entire episode without having to say a thing, and then X+Metal writes a letter about F’Ranatic. I absolutely want a SCRPG story where , to skip to the big reveal at the end, it turns out that Hathor was out there somewhere, the original Egyptian goddess of fertility, or a person with her artifact. And she didn’t hate Ra, but she hated the fact that she never got to have interaction (if you know what I’m saying, or maybe not like that, but Egypt was a raunchy enough culture that it’s probably that). So now she has a weird grudge against Fanatic, and wants to manipulate this nearly all-powerful angel to use her reality,-altering powers and impregnate herself with a resurrected Ra (probably named Harpocrates, the baby resurrection of Horus, who wasn’t necessarily always Ra in the myths, but that connection was there).
